correctness.rationale: A nonempty noncomplete undirected H has an opinion a with both a neighbor b and a nonneighbor c: otherwise any vertex incident to an edge would be universal, forcing every vertex incident and then H complete. Take all other vertices at opinion a and cycle the focal vertex through a,c,b,a. Only b→a has a conformity increment; unanimous a-neighbors occur with probability one for every allowed q. The forward/reverse rate-product ratio is (u+v)/u; positive reset rates ensure irreducibility. For q=1 on K_N the empty-confidence rates are symmetric, and the complete-confidence rates have the same ratio as the rising-factorial weight, including the subtraction of the changed vertex from the reverse target count. Uniform resampling at p=1 is separately reversible. On K₂ the count process is an exact lumping and its rates have the factor nᵢ for available changing vertices. The asserted masses sum to one and satisfy the balance equations, with opposite flows canceling outside the two oriented current triangles. Each triangle contributes J log((3−2p)/p); counting unordered edges prevents a factor-of-two error. Differentiating p(1−p) log((3−2p)/p) proves strict concavity on (0,1/2) and a negative derivative on [1/2,1), with zero endpoint limits. Independent replay, python3 /workspace/frozen_math_replay.py 3, reconstructs exact count flows by aggregating labeled transitions for four p values, then finds the peak p≈0.291984797141795 and rate ≈0.064719539702587. The bounded replay corroborates, not substitutes for, the symbolically valid reasoning.
residual_risks: The entropy production asserted is count-chain entropy production at the specified timescale, not a general assertion about coarse-graining or other populations.

Irisarri et al. give detailed-balance and entropy-production relations in a binary all-to-all model and a later extension with different rate structure.

originality.rationale: This assessment credits the known noisy copying generators, standard Kolmogorov and entropy-production principles, and the familiar reversible complete-confidence product weights as ingredients. What is distinct on the inspected evidence is the graph- and q-independent partial-confidence obstruction with its exact affinity, the resulting sharp confidence-graph classification in the q=1 complete-social subfamily, and the evaluated K₂ count circulation law and maximum. The available sources do not contain these evaluated conclusions.
residual_risks: A more general published confidence-specific reversibility theorem could imply part of the conclusion; this limited comparison does not establish publication priority.

value.rationale: The result separates social topology and unanimity from compatibility: the smallest possible directed cycle already witnesses microscopic irreversibility uniformly in both social parameters. The exact q=1 boundary and two-person current give natural benchmarks for when stationary opinion circulation persists and how it depends on uniform reset noise.
residual_risks: The sharp converse and explicit entropy rate apply only within their stated subfamilies.
